subject: Proposed Saturday Walk for the Hobby Club
text: Dear Alex, I am hoping you can help me organize the upcoming club activity. I am thinking of the Saturday morning walk around the river path, since the weather forecast is mild and the route is suitable for most members. I would like to invite both newer participants and older ones who have not joined us for a while, as I think a relaxed outdoor meeting could be a good way to reconnect. The plan would be to start at the east gate at ten, move at a gentle pace, and stop near the small café after about ninety minutes. This would allow people who prefer a shorter distance to turn back easily. I would also suggest a simple sign-in sheet by email, so we can arrange enough refreshments without making assumptions. If you have a helpful suggestion about a quieter route or a more convenient meeting point, I would really value it. You know many members well, and your input would make the event feel more welcoming. I will handle the basic logistics once I hear your thoughts, including confirming the café opening time and sending a brief reminder with clear directions. I am keeping the costs minimal for now, though I may ask each person to cover their own drink. Please let me know whether the time works, whether the route sounds inviting, and whether you would like to help share the invitation. Thank you for your time and support. Sincerely, Jamie
